id./param/scenario/cs/b_100_cs_060.pack|cs_: "Terrible! Terrible!
"What, Atsuo! So noisy! We're in the middle of an important prayer rite!
"This is no time for that! The dragon...! The man-eating fire dragon is alive!
"What are you saying? Lady Miko slew the man-eating fire dragon, didn't she...
"The dragon isn't dead! It's hiding deep in the volcano! I saw it myself, no mistake!
"You... Surely you didn't enter the volcano!? With the monster there, how...
"There's no more monster on the path! Because that monster was me!
"...What?
"I pretended to be a monster and kidnapped the sacrifice, so the rite wouldn't be done!
"Do you realize what you've done!? Without the rite, the god of fire will be angered and the village become a sea of flames!
"Shut up, liar! You've been playing the great hero and deceiving the villagers!
"You couldn't kill the dragon! So to save yourself you sold the villagers to the dragon!
"The god of fire's anger is a lie! The sacrifices get eaten by the man-eating dragon!
"...That's right! You were the only one to survive the fight with the dragon...
"Because you made Ryu, who fought with you, a sacrifice to the dragon, didn't you!?
"Silence!!
"Boy! What do you know!?
"Waah... Waaaah!
"What's going on...? Didn't Miko slay the man-eating dragon...?
"If the dragon is really alive... we'll all be eaten! I won't have that!
"Calm yourselves, everyone!
"Do not worry. My son Ryu surely slew the man-eating dragon. He died taking the dragon with him.
"Boy, you've meddled! What you are doing is blasphemy against the god of fire. The village will face divine judgment!
"Tell me where you hide your mother! Then I'll perform the sacrifice rite at once and calm the god's anger!
"Never! I'll never give Mum to you! I won't!
"Grooooaaaaar...!
"Wh-What was that sound...!?
"Surely not...!
"Could it be...!
"We can't stay! Come on, brother! Let's go outside too!"
